5.2. Third-Party Components

PlayForm builds upon and includes the following major third-party libraries and frameworks. Each is used under its respective open-source license.

Component Usage Website
mpv Media playback engine — audio/video decoding, rendering, and streaming for all supported formats mpv.io
Qt / PySide6 Cross-platform graphical user interface framework qt.io
FFmpeg Audio/video transcoding, extraction, thumbnail generation, audiobook binding, and format conversion ffmpeg.org
Deno JavaScript runtime used internally by yt-dlp for resolving streaming URLs deno.land
yt-dlp YouTube and streaming platform URL resolver for online media playback github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp
mutagen Audio metadata reading and writing, used alongside music-tag for the Tag Editor github.com/quodlibet/mutagen
pysubs2 Subtitle parsing, writing, and conversion library for the Subtitle Converter and Editor github.com/tkarabela/pysubs2
Qt Text-to-Speech / SAPI5 Speech synthesis engine for the Speech Converter tool and spoken accessibility feedback doc.qt.io/qt-6/qttexttospeech-index.html
ExifTool Reference implementation for PlayForm's media metadata engine; portions of its parsing approach were adapted into it exiftool.org
